name: Grand Piano with Bench
summary: Original 88-key baby grand with a raised lid, three pedals, castered legs and matching bench.
description: Brand-neutral black-lacquer baby grand for the S15 showroom podium, with curved bentside, propped open lid, open music desk and a simplified brass harp. Static visual equipment.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and shared procedural materials; no external assets or text.

display.origin: Floor centre of the complete piano-and-bench footprint

accuracy_notes: Dimensions use glTF XYZ (width, height, depth). Piano footprint is measured separately from the complete set; the 1.812 m raised-lid envelope exceeds the 0.993 m case top. 88 keys A0-C8: 52 white and 36 black. The bench is separate geometry within the same asset. Static display: no audio, key actuation, lid animation or engineering-grade internal mechanism. String courses are simplified. Full S15 assembly, physical devices and hardware performance are unverified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and materials; no external models, fonts, textures or logos.
